6226.title: Active-goal continuation event-path diagnostic
6226.rootCauseOneLine: Native trigger remains unknown; scripted probes retain active goal state and forward supplied continuation events.
6226.proposedFix: Capture a native failure trace and add a failing boundary regression before choosing a fix; do not add an unproven watchdog.
6226.caveats: Verified means the same agent repeated the bounded probe in a second clean checkout. No native scheduler failure or end-to-end incident was reproduced.
